newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus police investigate attack on Britons.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus police investigate attack on Britons.

text.p: Police in Cyprus said on Tuesday they were searching for a man alleged to have assaulted and slightly injured two female British tourists in separate incidents at the coastal resort of Paphos on Monday night.

The two women, identified as Linda Lahiff, 33, and Ellen Brooks, 45, were attacked by an unknown assailant holding a sharp instrument, they told police. Both women sustained minor scratches on their thighs. They received first aid at Paphos hospital and were discharged, police said.
The two assaults occurred in the space of 20 minutes as the women were walking along busy streets in the western resort with their husbands. The descriptions of the attacker matched, police said.
"Tens (dozens) of youths were summoned to police and questioned, so far without result. Inquiries are continuing," a police spokesman said.
The eastern Mediterranean island is generally crime free, visited by thousands of British tourists each year.
